lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Hello, Zoo Keeper.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Do you remember me?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: We've met a few times before.
Remind me again?
Of course I remember you.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: What? Are you being serious?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'm Leona, from Happy Zoo.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: The one always walking around with a pet lion.
Ah, okay.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Do you remember me now?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: ... I feel kinda sad all of a sudden.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I knew you would!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Apparently, we're going to be working together from here on out.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'm looking forward to it!
As am I.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: So, I have to ask:

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Do you know how to handle big animals?
Why? Will I have to handle them at some point?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: You don't have to, but at the shelter,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Biscuit is in charge of the dogs,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Nero is in charge of the cats,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: and I'm in charge of all the big animals.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: You'll get to meet them next time you swing by.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Personally, I think it'd be best if you came as often as possible, so that they'll warm up to you.
I'm a bit scared.
Sounds fun.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: They may look scary on the outside,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: but I've trained them myself, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: They're nothing but big softies,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: the whole lot of 'em.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'm glad to see you aren't scared at all.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: They're all super well-trained, so they're not a danger to anyone.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'm sure you'll all become fast friends, hehe.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Anyway, Timi is pestering me to get fed.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'll talk to you later.
